author: Pontoppidan, 1763
summary: 우리나라에서 드물게 관찰되는 겨울철새로, 습지와 풀밭, 대초원, 저지대 숲을 즐겨 찾는다. 들쥐, 작은 들새, 곤충 따위를 먹는다. 한배에 알을 4~8개 낳아 24~28일 품고, 새끼는 12~17일 동안 기른다. 구북구의 한대와 온대에 걸쳐 유럽, 시베리아, 북극 툰드라, 우수리, 아무르, 캄차카, 키르기스 초원, 몽골 북부, 중국 동북 지방까지 넓게 분포한다.

points.ko: 거의 안 보이는 매우 짧은 귀깃
points.en: very short, barely visible ear tufts

art.subject: Short-eared Owl (Asio flammeus), adult (sexes similar), as seen over Korean grasslands and marshes in winter: overall tawny-buff; pale buff-white facial disc with black patches surrounding the eyes; upperparts buff heavily blotched and streaked dark brown; breast boldly streaked dark brown, the streaks becoming fine and sparse on the paler, whitish-buff belly, with no cross-bars. Bill blackish; eyes yellow; legs and feet feathered buff.
art.pose: perched low on a grassy tussock in open marsh
art.scene: Korean winter wetland and grassland with dry grasses and reeds; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a low tussock: tawny-buff body with bold brown streaks, rounded head with tiny ear tufts barely showing, yellow eyes set in black patches
adult in flight, seen from below: pale underwing with black carpal crescent and black wingtips, streaked breast, whitish lower belly, barred tail
art.build: Medium-sized owl, 33–43cm, about the size of a feral pigeon or a little larger, with a rounded head and tiny ear tufts that are usually invisible. Bill short and hooked. Long, rather narrow wings: from below the underwing is whitish with a black carpal crescent and black wingtips; from above a buff patch at the base of the primaries, a dark carpal patch and a white trailing edge; tail barred. Flies low over open ground with floppy wingbeats and glides on wings held in a shallow V. Perches low on the ground or on posts.
avoid: Do not paint long ear tufts or orange eyes; those belong to Long-eared Owl (Asio otus).
Do not paint fine cross-bars on the belly streaks (Long-eared Owl).
Do not perch it high in dense forest; it hunts and rests in open grassland and marsh.
